出版者的话
古希腊圣哲亚里士多德曾说：“任何人都会生气，这没什么难的，但若要适时适所地以适当方式对适当对象恰如其分地生气，可就难上加难了。”而我们现在讲的情绪管理指的就是要适时适所地对适当对象恰如其分地表达情绪。
现实生活中，人们越来越多地认识到情绪管理能力的重要性，因为这方面能力出众的人往往在各个领域都游刃有余；相反，此项能力差的人，虽然可能很聪明，但做起事来往往很吃力。
情绪管理能力虽部分得益于先天因素，但归根结底还得靠后天的学习和培养，而幼儿时期是情绪管理能力培养的黄金时期。一个人在幼儿时期所获得的情绪经验和习惯会在大脑中形成永久的神经联结，对其身心发展影响很长远。
当前，亲子共读情绪管理类图画书这种情绪管理能力培养方式已被广泛认可。优质的图画书好比幸福的种子，通过父母的声音飞进孩子的耳朵里，植根在孩子的心底，施以阳光、雨露就能生根、发芽。
这套有趣的动物图画故事书温情脉脉，每一本都是有针对性地就孩子的某一种情绪话题展开，描绘孩子的心路历程，揭示其走出情绪困扰并解决问题的过程。每一本书都附有幼教专家精心撰写的导读，可作为家长亲子共读时的参考。
让我们在这套书的陪伴下，去享受一段美妙的亲子阅读之旅吧！

Publisher's Note
The ancient Greek philosopher Aristotle once said: 'Everyone gets angry, and that's not difficult. But to be angry at the right time, in the right place, with the right person, and in the right way, that's much harder.' What we now call emotional management is precisely about expressing emotions appropriately, at the right time and place, toward the right person.
In real life, people are increasingly recognizing the importance of emotional management skills, because those who excel in this area often thrive in various fields; conversely, those who lack this skill, though perhaps intelligent, often struggle in their endeavors.
While emotional management skills may partly stem from innate factors, they ultimately rely on learning and cultivation. Early childhood is the golden period for developing emotional management skills. The emotional experiences and habits formed during this period create permanent neural connections in the brain, profoundly influencing a child's physical and mental development.
Currently, the method of cultivating emotional management skills through parent-child reading of emotional management picture books is widely recognized. High-quality picture books are like seeds of happiness, carried by parents' voices into children's ears, taking root in their hearts, and with sunlight and rain, they can grow and sprout.
This series of heartwarming animal picture storybooks is designed to address specific emotional topics for children, depicting their inner journeys and revealing how they overcome emotional challenges and solve problems. Each book includes a carefully written guide by early childhood education experts, serving as a reference for parents during parent-child reading.
Let us enjoy a wonderful parent-child reading journey with this series!

Teacher Says to You
Listening to the Sound of Flowers Blooming
This is a picture book about childhood friendship. The story features a cute little panda named Lili. He has bright, clear eyes, just like his pure and kind heart. Lili longs for a playmate, but the little brown bear ignores him. Lili blames his own ugly appearance for this. To get close to the brown bear, Lili disguises himself as the brown bear. What method does he use? Will the brown bear find out? Will they become friends? These mysteries will be unraveled one by one through the story's thrilling plot. After reading this book, one cannot help but admire the author's profound understanding of children's psychology, allowing us to hear the voice from within children's hearts.
This story reminds me of my own childhood and the playmates I had back then. We used to climb trees, fish, laugh together, and cry together in groups of three or five. These memories are like beautiful flowers, quietly blooming deep in my heart, and whenever I think of them, they emit a faint fragrance.
Indeed, childhood should be spent with companions. Research shows that good friendships in early childhood can give children a sense of belonging and security, help reduce stress, and improve emotional intelligence and adaptability. title_en: Little Panda Looks for a Friend
page_text_ocr_zh:
钢筋水泥增加了现实的阻隔，虚拟网络制造了更多的隔膜，这些都在人们之间树起了屏障，使人与人之间产生了距离。

其实每个人都渴望真正的友谊，都会羡慕小熊猫和小棕熊，可以那样坦诚相见。小熊猫缺乏自信和勇气，但小棕熊是善解人意的，他给予朋友最大的宽容与理解。真正的友谊，不就是这样吗？无关乎外表，无关乎贫富，无关乎地位与背景。

本书中，小熊猫刚出场的时候，树上有三只小鸟，每一只都有不同的动作和表情，还出现了一只长长的鼻子，其后的画面中小鸟们也经常出现，还有猫头鹰来过。可以说，不管是快乐还是伤心，始终都有人陪在小熊猫的身边。他们也同样有着明亮无邪的大眼睛，充满了友善。相信这绝不是作者或画家随意的安排，也许是在提示我们——其实，我们并不是真的缺少朋友，我们缺少的也许仅仅是一个微笑、一声“你好”而已。

读完这个故事，我们还可以和孩子一起讨论这样一些问题：小熊猫为什么要让自己变成小棕熊？小棕熊不理小熊猫是因为它丑吗？真正的原因是什么呢？对朋友说谎好不好？如果你是小熊猫，你会怎么做呢？这样，孩子就会独立思考，真正领会这个故事的美好内涵。

（保定市教科所教研员 刘育红）
page_text_en:
Reinforced concrete increases the barriers of reality, and virtual networks create more隔膜, all of which erect barriers between people, causing distance between individuals.

In fact, everyone longs for true friendship and envies the panda and the brown bear, who can meet with such sincerity. The panda lacks confidence and courage, but the brown bear is understanding and kind-hearted, offering his friend the greatest tolerance and understanding. Isn't true friendship exactly like this? Regardless of appearance, wealth, status, or background.

In this book, when the panda first appears, there are three little birds in the tree, each with different actions and expressions. A long nose also appears, and later in the illustrations, the birds often appear again, along with an owl. It can be said that, whether happy or sad, someone is always by the panda's side. They also have bright, innocent big eyes, full of kindness. I believe this is not a random arrangement by the author or illustrator; perhaps it is a reminder to us — in fact, we are not truly lacking friends; what we may be missing is just a smile, or a simple 'hello'.

After reading this story, we can also discuss these questions with children: Why did the panda want to turn himself into the brown bear? Is it because the brown bear didn't like the panda because it was ugly? What is the real reason? Is it okay to lie to a friend? If you were the panda, what would you do? In this way, children will think independently and truly understand the beautiful meaning of this story.

(Baoding City Educational Research Institute, Researcher Liu Yuhong)

小熊猫力力和熊猫爸爸正在度假的森林里散步，

page_text_en:
Little panda Lili and Panda Dad were walking in the forest during their vacation.
They discovered a brown "panda" near a cave.
Lili was surprised: "This panda is strange."
"He's not a panda, he's a brown bear," Panda Dad corrected.
Little panda Lili smiled brightly at the little brown bear,
but the little brown bear turned his head away and ignored Lili.
"The little brown bear isn't friendly at all!" Lili grumbled unhappily.

日子一天一天过去，力力越来越不开心。

page_text_en:
Days went by, and Lili became more and more unhappy.
He always thought of the little brown bear and wanted to play with him.
But every time he waved or made funny faces at the little brown bear,
the little brown bear ignored him, as if the little panda were invisible.
The little panda Lili sighed and said:
"It must be because I'm too ugly, without the beautiful brown fur like the little brown bear,
so he doesn't pay attention to me."

title_en: Little Panda Looks for a Friend
summary_zh: 画面描绘了一片色彩斑斓的森林，一只穿着红色背带裤的小棕熊坐在树枝上，另一只小棕熊站在地面，手持白色物品，表情专注。背景中有粉色树叶、彩色花朵和一只小鸟，整体氛围温馨活泼。

title_en: Little Panda Looks for a Friend
page_text_ocr_zh:
但是，当力力把蒙住眼睛的头巾摘下来的时候，
抹掉了一些巧克力粉。
“咦？你的眼睛周围怎么是黑色的呢？”格里斯很惊讶。
“呃……我……我刚才撞到了。”
力力一边挠头，一边结结巴巴地回答。
page_text_en:
But when Lili took off the scarf covering her eyes,
 she rubbed off some chocolate powder.
"Huh? Why are the areas around your eyes black?" Grees was surprised.
"Uh... I... I just bumped into something."
Lili scratched her head and stammered in response.
summary_zh: 力力在玩蒙眼游戏后摘下头巾，不小心蹭掉了脸上的巧克力粉，露出了黑眼圈，被格里斯发现并询问，力力慌忙编造借口说是撞到了。

title_en: Little Panda Looks for a Friend
page_text_ocr_zh:
但是，小棕熊格里斯还是不放过力力：
“咦？你的头上还有一块白白的斑！
幸亏格里斯的妈妈这时来了，
她的手里还拿着冰激凌。
“快吃吧，不然你们的冰激凌就要化了！”，
page_text_en:
But little brown bear Gris still didn't let go of Lili:
"Huh? There's still a white spot on your head!"
Luckily, Gris's mom arrived just then,
and she was holding an ice cream.
"Eat quickly, or your ice cream will melt!"
summary_zh: 格里斯发现力力头上还有白斑，正想追问时，格里斯的妈妈拿着冰激凌出现，转移了注意力。

title_en: Little Panda Looks for a Friend
summary_zh: 画面中，小熊猫力力和小棕熊格里斯正在开心地吃着冰激凌，背景是温暖的森林，有猫头鹰和小鸟在树洞中观望，整体氛围温馨愉快。

title_en: Little Panda Looks for a Friend
summary_zh: 画面中，小熊猫力力露出大大的眼睛和黑眼圈，双手捂住嘴巴，显得惊讶或害羞；旁边是小棕熊格里斯，面带微笑，似乎在注视力力。背景是粉色调的森林，氛围温馨。

title_en: Little Panda Looks for a Friend
page_text_ocr_zh:
哇！冰激凌实在是太好吃啦！
小熊猫力力舔了舔爪子，一点儿都不想浪费。
“咦？力力，你的爪子怎么变成黑色的了？”小棕熊很好奇。
“因为……因为……我把爪子弄脏了！”小熊猫力力结结巴巴地说。
力力也觉得自己说谎说得太多了，于是赶紧转移话题：
“我们继续玩儿吧！”
于是，他们就接着玩儿，
一直到天黑了，连力力的妈妈在叫力力都没听见。
他们也没听见“轰隆隆”的雷声。
page_text_en:
Wow! Ice cream is really delicious!
Little panda Lili licked her paws, not wanting to waste a bit.
"Huh? Lili, how did your paws turn black?" asked the little brown bear, curious.
"Because... because... I got my paws dirty!" Lili stammered.
Lili felt she had lied too much, so she quickly changed the subject:
"Let's keep playing!"
So they kept playing,
until it got dark, and they didn't even hear their mom calling Lili.
They also didn't hear the "boom" of thunder.
summary_zh: 力力和格里斯继续玩耍，力力因说谎而转移话题，两人玩到天黑，甚至没听见妈妈的呼唤和雷声。

title_en: Little Panda Looks for a Friend
summary_zh: 画面中，小熊猫力力在雨中奔跑，表情惊讶，背景是色彩斑斓的森林，一只红色小鸟在树枝上观望，整体氛围充满动感与自然气息。

title_en: Little Panda Looks for a Friend
page_text_ocr_zh:
突然，风雨大作，
小棕熊和小熊猫连忙躲进了洞里。
力力身上涂的巧克力粉都被冲掉了。

summary_zh: 突然下起大雨，小棕熊和小熊猫急忙躲进洞里，力力身上的巧克力粉被雨水冲掉了。

title_en: Little Panda Looks for a Friend
page_text_ocr_zh:
格里斯终于看到了力力的真面目！
“原来你是熊猫呀！”
小熊猫力力很羞愧，一句话也不说。
小棕熊接着说：“但你为什么要打扮成棕熊呢？”
小熊猫解释道：“因为我想和你一起玩儿，但是你总是不理我，
我想可能是因为我和你不一样吧！”
“不是这样的！你不知道吗？棕熊的视力都特别差！
只有你来到我身边时，我才能看到你呢！”小棕熊笑笑说。
page_text_en:
Gris finally saw Lili's true face!
"So you're a panda!"
The little panda Lili felt very ashamed and didn't say a word.
The little brown bear continued, "But why did you dress up as a brown bear?"
The little panda explained, "Because I wanted to play with you, but you always ignored me.
I thought it might be because I'm different from you!"
"That's not it! Don't you know? Brown bears have very poor eyesight!
Only when you come close to me can I see you!" the little brown bear said with a smile.
summary_zh: 格里斯终于看清了力力的真实身份，力力解释自己扮成棕熊是为了能和格里斯一起玩，而格里斯则坦白自己视力不好，只有力力靠近时才能看到他。

title_en: Little Panda Looks for a Friend
summary_zh: 画面中，小熊猫力力和小棕熊格里斯在洞穴内，力力低着头显得有些难过，格里斯则伸出胳膊轻轻搭在力力肩上，似乎在安慰他。背景是温暖的黄色洞穴，上方悬挂着一盏灯泡，墙上挂着一幅简笔画，整体氛围温馨而安静。

title_en: Little Panda Looks for a Friend
summary_zh: 画面中，小棕熊格里斯闭着眼睛，面带微笑，似乎在享受宁静的森林时光。背景是粉紫色调的竹林，氛围温馨而梦幻，右下角有二维码和推广文字，但无对话或叙述性文字。

title_en: Little Panda Looks for a Friend
page_text_ocr_zh:
力力松了一口气。
后来，他终于看到了正在苦苦寻找他的熊猫妈妈。
这时他才想到，妈妈一定担心极了。
力力忐忑不安地问小棕熊：
“我现在该回家了。你……你不会怪我吧？”
“当然不怪你！我怎么会怪你呢？即使你是小熊猫，
我们仍然是好朋友呀！”
page_text_en:
Lili sighed in relief.
Later, he finally saw his panda mom searching for him.
Only then did he realize how worried his mom must be.
Lili asked the little brown bear nervously:
"I should go home now. You... you won't be mad at me, right?"
"Of course not! Why would I be mad at you? Even if you're a little panda,
we're still good friends!"
summary_zh: 力力在森林中找到妈妈后，向小棕熊格里斯道别并询问是否会被怪罪，格里斯表示不会生气，两人仍是好朋友。

title_en: Little Panda Looks for a Friend
page_text_ocr_zh:
从此以后，小棕熊格里斯和小熊猫力力
成为了世界上最要好的好朋友。
即使他们的外表不同，但他们仍然形影不离！
